bullets.text: MagSafe Battery Pack Triumph - **Kuxiu S3** offers multifunctionality and reliability, replacing multiple chargers effectively.
SwitchBot Wallet Finder - This sleek accessory integrates with **Find My** to help locate lost wallets effortlessly.
Waymo's Robotaxi Resumes - After a blackout caused service disruptions, **Waymo** is back on the streets of San Francisco.
Bankruptcy Hits Hardware Firms - **iRobot**, **Luminar**, and **Rad Power Bikes** face bankruptcy amid industry challenges.
EU Softens EV Goals - The revised 2035 plan allows hybrids, raising concerns among **EV startups** about competitiveness.
ChatGPT Voice Feature Retiring - **OpenAI** will discontinue the Voice feature on macOS by January 2026.
PayPal's Honey Under Fire - **PayPal's** Honey extension faces backlash over alleged unethical practices affecting influencers.
